Here's what I can do with past questions:

📎 Send a past question PDF or photo with caption:
PQ: [Course Name] [Year]
Example: PQ: Digital Electronics 2022

📩 After I process it, reply:
ANSWER: 3  (to get model answer for question 3)

⏱ Or reply:
SIMULATE  (to run a timed exam simulation)
❌ Failed to download or process the file. Please try again, or send the file in a different format.
